record.field: select c.maktx, a.meins, a.mtart, a.matkl, d.mtbez, a.ntgew, a.matnr, b.LVORM, b.werks, b.xchpf, e.meinh, e.umrez, e.umren, d.spras, a.mhdhb, a.IPRKZ from mara a join marc b on a.mandt=b.mandt and a.matnr=b.matnr join makt c on a.mandt=c.mandt and a.matnr=c.matnr join t134t d on a.mandt=d.mandt and a.mtart=d.mtart and d.spras='E' join marm e on a.matnr=e.matnr where a.mtart = 'FERT'

select a.matnr, b.maktx, a.werks, a.lgort, c.meins, a.labst, a.insme, a.speme from mard a join mara c on a.matnr = c.matnr left join makt b on a.matnr = b.matnr and b.spras = 'E' where a.lgort = 'FINI'
select a.fnsh_good, a.PCKLBL,a.BAG_UOM, a.pack_desc,a.plant from ZPPAFDPACK a
select a.zkey1, a.zkey2, a.zkey3 from zcpro_trx a where a.group_id = 'ZPP_FEED_LINE'
select a.lgort, a.werks, a.lgobe from t001l a

select a.werks,a.vgbel, a.mjahr, a.arrdate, a.lgort, a.trucknr, b.kunnr, c.posnr, c.matnr, a.doqty, a.vrkme, d.umrez, d.umren, a.bktxt from zmm_ts_ret_bgh a left join zmm_ts_ret_bgd b on a.vgbel = b.vbeln LEFT JOIN vbap c ON a.vgbel = c.vbeln LEFT JOIN marm d ON c.matnr = d.matnr AND c.vrkme = d.meinh where a.mblnr != ' '
